## 0.5.2

- New setting: No capitals or punctuation. Turn it on in Settings and Dicta types everything in lowercase with no periods, commas or question marks. With Spoken commands on, punctuation you say out loud ("question mark", "comma") still appears. Numbers, times, links, emails and anything in backticks stay as they are, but numbered list markers lose their dot ("1. milk" becomes "1 milk").
